# Company Overview
Reversun is an enterprise software engineering company built on first-principles systems architecture and high-velocity engineering based in India.
Website: https://www.reversun.com
Inquiries: info@reversun.com

# Core Offerings

## 1. Proprietary Software Products
- Presenza: Intelligent, high-speed attendance application engineered to complete full classroom and college attendance in approximately 1 minute, eliminating roll-call delays and proxy errors.
- QuanBit: AI-based interactive quantum algorithm learning and simulation platform featuring a live Quantum Circuit Lab with Qiskit Aer, interactive 3D Bloch sphere visualization, and Schrödinger AI Socratic tutoring. Official website: https://www.quanbit.tech/

## 2. Engineering Services
- AI & Automation: Autonomous agent workflows, process automation, RAG search, LLM integrations, and intelligent pipelines.
- Web & App Development: Sub-second latency full-stack web and cross-platform mobile apps engineered with Next.js, React, and modern micro-runtimes.
- System Design: High-load distributed systems, microservices architecture, and fault-tolerant cloud messaging.
- Cloud Infrastructure: Multi-cloud orchestration across AWS, Azure, Supabase, and containerized meshes delivering 99.99% uptime.
